theorems.name: Submission.dor_ims_lusin_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable f μ → 0 < ε → ∃ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ A ∧ μ (A \ K) < ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ ContinuousOn f K
